description_en: The three-bayedphalcāstands on the eastern edge of Bhindyaḥlāchi square, on the lane that leads from Balkhu (south) to Cyāsala (north). On its northern side, it is connected to the Bhansā Sataḥ (LAL4140). Thephalcāwas originally built by the Avāles of Lāmanaṃ Guṭhī(theguṭhīof non-meat eaters), the Cidhā Guṭhī and the Cidhā Khalaḥ Guṭhī of Bhindyaḥlāchi area (Tiwari1994, pp. 30 and 60). Thephalcāwas dismantled and rebuilt in 2018 with support from the Lalitpur municipality. Five simple 19th-century columns are incorporated into the new structure.
description_ne: भिन्द्यलाछि चोकमा रहेको तीन वटा कवल भएको यो फल्चा नगरपालिकाको सहयोगमा सन् २०१८ मा भत्काएर पुनर्निर्माण गर्न सुरु गरिएको २०१८ अक्टोबरमा नै निर्माणकार्य सम्पन्न भएको छ । यस फल्चामा १९ औँ शताब्दीका पाँच वटा सादा काष्ठस्तम्भ प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यो फल्चा उत्तरतर्फ भन्सा सतःसँग जोडिएको छ । यो फल्चा भिन्द्यलाछीका लामनं गुठीका अवालेहरूले स्थापना गरेका हुन् ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)

historical_events.event_description: Reconstruction of the Phalcā by the Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City and the local community.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation, Donation and Offering of a roof
historical_events.event_description: Renovation of the Phalcā and offering of the roof by a group led by a person named Devisaṃṣa. The stone inscription (28 cm high, 16.5 cm wide) is attached to the centre of the back wall.The stone inscription of Dhaubaji phalcā is attached to the eastern wall. On the top of the inscription Lord Bhimsen's attribute, a club, is carved.
